subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93620 as the canonical fix path for this issue, including its route-accurate proof scope if live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 proof remains unavailable?
rationale: The source gap is clear and the linked PR targets the right surfaces, but the remaining action is maintainer review/proof acceptance rather than a new automated fix lane.

options.title: Review And Refresh Linked PR
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR as the canonical fix path, resolving any current merge or CI state before landing.

options.title: Require Live Provider Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a redacted live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload capture before accepting the fix.

options.title: Replace The Candidate Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the linked PR only if maintainers choose a different implementation path for the same transcript and sanitizer gates.
